message.content:
The Declaration of Independence was signed by 56 delegates representing the thirteen American colonies. The signers were:

| State | Signers |
|-------|---------|
| **Delaware** | Thomas McKean, George Read, Caesar Rodney |
| **Pennsylvania** | John Morton, George Clymer, Benjamin Franklin, Robert Morris, George Taylor, James Smith |
| **New Jersey** | William Livingston, John Witherspoon, Abraham Clark, John Hart, William Livingston, John Witherspoon |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Adams, Samuel Adams, John Hancock, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere, John Hancock |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Hooper, John Rutledge |
| **New Hampshire** | John Langdon, Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple |
| **Virginia** | Richard Henry Lee, Francis Lightfoot Lee, Carter Braxton, George Wythe, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, James Monroe, Patrick Henry, George Mason, Edmund Randolph, Thomas Jefferson |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Lewis Morris, Robert R. Livingston, John Jay |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **Rhode Island** | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery, Matthew Thornton |

These individuals signed the document on August 2, 1776, and it was officially adopted on July 4, 1776.
